The carefully constructed lies, hidden desires, and painful truths of the past begin to unravel, exposing a world of deception and obsession one layer at a time.

show.name: Where the Mask Ends
show.summary: Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.

show.name: Mind the Boy
show.summary: Jang Gi U is a 32-year-old temporary high school teacher. Four years ago, he became the subject of an inappropriate rumor involving a student. As a result, he never took the teacher certification examination and has instead spent the years moving from one contract teaching position to another. Raised in a single-mother household, he grew up constantly hearing that he had to be someone with "no flaws in the eyes of others." He lives as a person who appears flawless, but his life feels dull and unremarkable. At least, that is what everyone says.

show.name: Besties' Coming Fortune
show.summary: Modern-day best friends Tian Yuyuan and Lin Shutiao unexpectedly find themselves transported into a novel about household power struggles. They become sisters-in-law destined to be framed in a flower boat scandal on their wedding night and die together as sacrificial characters. The two team up to thwart the eldest sister-in-law and the adopted daughter, Shen Wanwan, as they expose one scheme and trap after another, making money along the way to survive. Shen Cheng, the cold and aloof heir, is afflicted with a deadly poison and needs the heroine's blood to stay alive, while Shen He, the unruly third young master, secretly aspires to become a coroner. Romance gradually blossoms between the two couples. However, the reborn original heroine Song Zhang and the Third Prince, who plots rebellion, launch a series of attacks. The four join forces to investigate an old case at Qiyun Pass, find witnesses who can testify to the injustice, and expose the Third Prince's serious crimes. They clear the Shen family's name and ultimately escape their predetermined tragic fate, living peacefully together.

show.name: Dear Song
show.summary: To seek justice for her father, Yu Song takes a job as an assistant in the Song household. Her sincerity wins Song Cheng over, and she teams up with Jing, a driver, to gather evidence and expose the Song family's crimes. But she refuses to let hatred consume her. She breaks free from what has held her back and realizes that real victory means taking control of her own life. In the end, she embraces life with newfound freedom and hope.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

Slow Horses follows the story of a group of British intelligence agents who serve in a dumping ground department of MI5 called Slough House after the big mistakes they've made that resulted in the end of their mainstream careers.

This quick-witted spy drama follows a dysfunctional team of MI5 agents—and their obnoxious boss, the notorious Jackson Lamb—as they navigate the espionage world's smoke and mirrors to defend England from sinister forces.

show.summary: Where's Wanda? tells the story of Dedo and Carlotta Klatt, who are desperate to locate their missing 17-year-old daughter Wanda, who disappeared months ago without a trace. When the police fail to find her, the family takes matters into their own hands, obtaining surveillance devices with the help of their tech-savvy son Ole. Disguising themselves as employees of an electrical company, they bug first their neighborhood and then half their suburb, finding out that behind closed doors none of their neighbors are who they pretend to be.

After being hit, Ye Bufan accidentally traveled to a fantasy world and obtained the inheritance of ancient medicine. From then on, he mastered medical skills, practiced martial arts, and won the favor of countless beautiful women.

show.summary: WWE Evolve will introduce viewers to the most intense and charismatic prospects recruited from college athletics and independent wrestling as they strive to build their in-ring careers and elevate their personas. WWE Evolve will prominently feature talent from WWE's world-class Performance Center in Orlando, Fla., and WWE ID, a first-of-its-kind developmental program.

show.name: Teach me, Touch me
show.summary: Dumped by his ex for being "too vanilla in bed," Gear decides to reinvent himself into someone confident and irresistible. To make it happen, he seeks out Kanthee, a top-tier playboy and charismatic luxury car mogul, to teach him the art of passion. As these intimate lessons unfold, their intense proximity blossoms into an uncontrollable bond. Kanthee discovers Gear's gentle, intriguing side, while Gear glimpses the genuine heart beneath Kanthee's playboy persona. When the line between lessons and feelings blurs, this thrilling connection might just end in falling in love. One came eager to learn, but the other ended up teaching way beyond the curriculum... In the end, who will fall first?

show.name: The Great Long March
show.summary: Revolving around the arduous Long March of the Central Red Army, it documents the historical process—from the army's failure in the fifth counter-encirclement campaign, to the First, Second, Fourth Front Armies of the Red Army and the 25th Red Army launching strategic transfers under the leadership of the CPC Central Committee—to eventual triumph. It extols the unyielding ideals and revolutionary spirit of Mao Zedong and Chinese Communists, and elucidates the history and logic behind the rise and development of the Chinese revolution, proving that adapting Marxism to China's specific conditions was essential for victory.

show.name: mofusand animation
show.summary: Shark Meow is an orange tabby kitty who wears a shark suit. A little clumsy and always taking things at their own cozy pace, but every day with their best kitty friends — and the rescued baby kitty, Little Meow — is filled with unexpected little mishaps and sweet adventures. A sunny warm spot in the park, the sparkle of the sea, steam rising from freshly roasted sweet potatoes, the fluttery feeling of the first snowfall… These small everyday moments fill their world with warmth and delight. You can't help but smile and think, "So true!" A soft and snuggly kitty anime that brings joy to everyday moments.

In the process of investigating the truth, he gradually uncovers the story of the conflict between humans and demons, the secrets of the dynasty, and the mystery of his own destiny.

show.name: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
show.summary: In this bold reimagining of one of history's most controversial social experiments, thirty willing participants enter a real prison and are randomly assigned as guards or prisoners. Thrust into a system of power, hierarchy, and control, they'll discover whether ordinary people inevitably conform to the roles they're given—or whether empathy, morality, and individuality can withstand the forces pushing them in the opposite direction. As the pressure builds and the balance of power begins to shift, the central question feels more urgent than ever: Does power corrupt?

Thrust into a system of power, hierarchy, and control, they'll discover whether ordinary people inevitably conform to the roles they're given—or whether empathy, morality, and individuality can withstand the forces pushing them in the opposite direction. As the pressure builds and the balance of power begins to shift, the central question feels more urgent than ever: Does power corrupt?
